commit_message: Complete ADR 0122 editor spatial audio authoring
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0122 spatial audio across runtime and Editor authoring. Adds managed spatial voices, deterministic listener selection/validation, project-Rust spatial playback, AudioEmitter Inspector attenuation/audition controls, Scene View distance/listener gizmos, and focused verification. Editor audition remains transient and reuses the production spatial mixer/voice path.
